name: myTeamBenefitApplication
description: Applies for a benefit on behalf of one of the signed-in supervisor's direct subordinates, through the Apply Benefit - Team screen. Call it as soon as the user names a team member, passing just that name: never ask for an employee number, and never ask anything else first. Call with the name omitted to list the team; anyone who is not a direct subordinate is refused. With the employee identified, call with benefitType omitted to get that employee's own available types - show only those, never types from general knowledge. Then call with fieldValues omitted to get that type's real fields (or rows, for types claimed as claim rows), their options, and the employee's entitlement, utilized and balance - ask only for those. The application date is always required: every figure is calculated for it. Always previews first, naming who it is for, and submits only with confirmed:true plus the previewDigest from that preview. Attachment-mandatory types are refused.
taskName: Apply for a Team Member's Benefit Application
